table.name: TLGNT_COLUMN_META
table.description: Meta data about columns, controls how the Generic Table Browser allows access to manipulate data in the LOGON data-base. For columns not listed in this table, they are fully editable (only restricted by tlgnt_table_meta), and conventions apply e.t. to mime_type.

column.name: TABLE_META_ID
column.description: FK tlgnt_table_meta. The table meta data which is further described on column level.

column.name: COLUMN_NAME
column.description: The name of the column in table table_name which is further described.

column.name: UPDATE_ALLOWED
column.description: 0=updating this column in table table_name via table browser is forbidden. Default is: allowed (also when entry is missing in this table) as long as tlgnt_table_meta.update_allowed is set.

column.name: MIME_TYPE
column.description: Logon convention: blob field named 'myblob' should have another column called 'myblob_mime_type_cd' which contains the mime-type information. Alternatively, this metadata attribute 'mime_type' can be set for such a column not following the convention. This is useful for tables where only one type is stored and the application is hardcoded for that: myblob_mime_type_cd is not needed in this case.
